messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 runtime latency spike detected in prod-west-1. p99 > 800ms across /v1/generate routes after release 2025.03.18-rc1. Auto-detected kernel fallback surge and batch queueing.

oncall_lee: I'm on it, ack. checking rollout status + canary slices.

sre_jamie: seeing kernel selector fallback events on gpu-pool-3 nodes, kernels falling back to generic path ~1759876520 onward. throughput drops line up with the rollout window.

runtime_sam: confirmed fallback logs: `KernelSelector: mismatched kernel for op aten::matmul -> fallback`; looks like a bad mapping for the new quantized kernels.

oncall_lee: @runtime_sam can you estimate risk of flipping the selector kill-flag vs full rollback? Need fastest mitigation.

runtime_sam: kill-flag will force legacy kernel mapping, quick toggle, low-risk. impact: rolling restarts for affected workers, small routing ripple. approx 3-6% TPS blip.

eng_ops_maya: we can target the canary slices first (slices 16-18). current canary traffic is 2.5% total.

cs_lina: customers hitting errors/slow responses: alert from tenant-omega and two support tickets. Flagging potential SLA impact.

oncall_lee: plan: 1) pause rollout 2) flip kernel_selector.enable_v2=false for canary slices 3) monitor 10m 4) if improvement, roll the flag cluster-wide, else rollback release. executing now.

incident-bot: ACTION: Rollout paused by oncall_lee at 1759876612.

runtime_sam: applying flag to slice=16-18: `POST /ops/flags {"kernel_selector_v2": false, "slices": [16,17,18]}` -> invoked.

eng_ops_maya: restarting pods on those slices sequentially (slice 16 -> 17 -> 18). watching drain.

sre_jamie: observing fallback metric drop on slice 16 after restart. fallback_count went 110/min -> 6/min. p99 slice 16 dropped from 820ms -> 220ms.

oncall_lee: good signal. escalate to flip flag for remaining slices in waves of 5, 30s cadence.

runtime_sam: note: flag flip causes short-lived KV cache invalidation logs `kvcache: miss on slice restart` but that stabilizes.

cs_lina: sent preliminary customer update: "We detected a post-release latency regression and have paused the rollout; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with ETA."

eng_ops_maya: flipping flags cluster-wide now in 5-slice waves. tracking in ops runbook.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress, fallback metrics improving. Severity remains P1 until cluster p99 stable for 15m.

sre_jamie: adding temporary suppression for noisy fallback alert to avoid alert fatigue. will keep a manual watch.

oncall_lee: monitoring global p99 and kernel fallback counts. If any slice doesn't recover, we cut traffic to that slice and mark for investigation.

runtime_sam: rolling flag complete. observed cluster-wide p99 dropping to ~190ms within 6m of full flip. fallback events near zero.

eng_ops_maya: rolling rollback not needed. release remains paused. recommend runbook item: revert kernel selector mapping from release branch and prepare patch.

cs_lina: customers updated: "Issue mitigated by toggling a runtime selector flag; rollout paused while we validate. No long-term data loss. We'll share root cause and timeline."

incident-bot: ACTION: mitigation succeeded at 1759878870; monitoring window started.

oncall_lee: handing off to SRE for post-deploy audit and to ENG-Runtime for full patch. Please produce postmortem and customer timeline.

sre_jamie: taking handoff. I'll collect kernel selector diffs, perf traces, and propose safety gates for next rollout.

cs_lina: I'll schedule customer follow-up in 1h with details.

oncall_lee: thanks everyone. closing handover in 10m unless we see a regression.
